SELECT json_agg(x) AS r FROM (
  SELECT c.name AS empresa,
    count(*) AS festas_90d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.payment_details IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_payments p WHERE p.event_id = e.id)) AS plano_sem_parcelas,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.payment_details IS NULL) AS sem_plano,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.child_name IS NULL AND (e.birthday_children IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(e.birthday_children) = 0)) AS sem_crianca,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.lead_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_lead
  FROM company_events e JOIN companies c ON c.id = e.company_id
  WHERE e.created_at > now() - interval '90 days' AND e.status <> 'cancelado'
  GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC
) x
